description: Manual browser: use a square fixture with visible corners and a long name; verify 48px expanded / 32px collapsed, intact corners, truncation, dashboard link and persisted collapse. Check desktop, narrow viewport and 200% zoom. Repeat square behavior in CE with wide fields still absent.

Manual browser: render tight 4:1 and 8:1 wordmarks; verify 192x48px and at most 224px width respectively at default zoom, undistorted complete artwork, no duplicate name/organization rows, and square rendering when collapsed.

Manual browser: switch light/dark sidebar surfaces with distinguishable logo variants, exercise a single supplied variant, fail the selected wide-image request, and remove branding. Confirm existing selection, square/default fallbacks and label restoration, with no new overflow or inaccessible navigation.

Manual browser: compare dashboard preview and live portal in both themes; verify 36px preview allocations, square corners and long-name containment. Confirm portal help says scaled to fit in localized content and that MSP sidebar/help are unchanged. Run existing sidebar contract tests and repository translation validation; record outcomes without treating them as visual proof.
